text: {"assertions":["A signature mismatch bug in crypto/keys/rotation.py appeared only on the staging read replica.","The root cause of the signature mismatch was floating point rounding errors in the money path.","The bug manifested as verification failures against the previous key during key rotation.","The bug could be reproduced by rotating the signing key while requests were in flight.","The fix involved moving arithmetic calculations from floating point to integer minor units.","The fix was implemented in PR #3500 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-1.","The flaky test in tests/crypto/test_rotation.py improved from 44 failures per 100 runs to zero after the fix."]}
